tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Most of every page is this colour: whitespace is the brand.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, flow nodes and capability blocks that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed bands, such as the client-list strip or a code/data well.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The one high-contrast band per page (the Principle section, the final CTA). Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline section dividers and list rules. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, flow-node outlines and connectors; 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy and the primary button fill. Reads on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, leads, eyebrows, nav links. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Index numerals (01, 02), metadata, disabled text. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (4.5:1+ in both themes); never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on the ink-filled primary button.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The single accent. Hover/active state of the primary button, focus ring, the outcome node of a flow, one highlighted figure per view. As text: on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken or signal-soft (4.9:1+ in both themes); never as text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind signal text, the outcome node in a FlowChain.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and arrows on a signal fill (5.8:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring offset 2px from the control, 3:1+ on every surface except surface-inverse, where ink-inverse is used instead.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: We Build Systems That Drive Growth.
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Drops to heading-1 below 720px wide.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Growth isn't a service. It's a system.
styles.usage: Section headlines (the line after each eyebrow).

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: Build the technology behind the business.
styles.usage: Closing statements and sub-headlines inside a section.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Numbered capability, step, industry and audience titles; set in uppercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: PlutoSolve is a Growth Systems Agency that helps businesses build the technology, marketing engines and processes they need.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a section headline, in ink-muted, max 640px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We understand the business, its customers, existing systems and the problem that needs to be solved.
styles.usage: All running copy. Bold (700) for the one line in a paragraph group that carries the point.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: We build the system around the outcome.
styles.usage: Punchlines and flow chains (Business → Customer → Problem → Opportunity).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Growth Strategy · Go-to-Market Strategy · Funnel Strategy

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, always uppercase, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, arrow gap fine-tuning.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Flow-node inner vertical padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and headline; flow-node horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing, list item spacing, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, connector length, card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between headline block and content; grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between capability blocks; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Inner section rhythm on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on tablet.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop. Be generous: the brief asks for plenty of whitespace.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Section bands, rules, the inverse band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, flow nodes, inputs: nearly square, precise.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and capability blocks when raised. Nothing rounder than this.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max measure for leads and body paragraphs.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Button height; 40px in SiteNav.
